facts.text: Traditional undergraduate students enrolled full-time in both Fall and Spring Terms charged comprehensive tuition may take one January Term course at no additional cost.

sources.title: Tuition, Housing, & Meal Plans | Elmhurst University Catalog
sources.quote: Traditional undergraduate students enrolled full-time (3.00 or more credit hours) in Fall and Spring Terms of the same academic year and charged for comprehensive tuition rates in those terms may take one January Term course at no additional cost

facts.text: Through The Chicago Promise, graduates of Chicago Public Schools who demonstrate financial need receive a scholarship covering 50% of tuition costs for up to four years of undergraduate study at Elmhurst University.

sources.title: The Elmhurst Promise | Elmhurst University
sources.quote: The scholarship will cover 50% of tuition costs for up to four years of undergraduate study at Elmhurst University.

sources.title: The Elmhurst Promise | Elmhurst University
sources.quote: To be eligible for this scholarship, students must have graduated from a Chicago Public School and must meet the academic requirements for admission to Elmhurst University. They must also demonstrate financial need
